What I especially appreciate is how easy she is to reach she’s super responsive on WhatsApp, which makes scheduling or asking quick questions really convenient. She’s also very helpful and caring, which makes the whole experience stress-free.

Highly recommend!

Visual Pricing: They have no prices on their website and charge you based on your appearance.
The 10-Minute Fraud: Charged 1,700 Baht for a 10-minute "Airflow" that medically requires 40 minutes.
Selective English: They speak English to take your money, but "forget" it when you complain about the bad service.
Broken Links: Their pricing page is intentionally broken to hide their overcharging.
This is a tourist trap, not a medical clinic. Go elsewhere.

The worst experience in my life ! The deep cleaning + airflow take 7-10 minutes . No matter how cutting-edge the equipment, Google the official medical protocol!! Teeth cleaning with an airflow takes at least 30 minutes.

A friend of mine in Jomtien recommended me to visit Ocean Dental Centre to investigate the cost of a crown, which my dentist in the UK had strongly advised me to have. After a thorough oral investigation I was quoted a price just a little over half what my UK dentist would have charged for a dental crown of the same quality. At my next appointment the excellent and friendly Thai dentist worked for over 2 hours with painstaking attention to every detail, right down to the matching of colours with neighbouring teeth – although ‘painstaking’ is an ill-chosen word here, as the whole procedure was completely painless. At the final session he fitted the newly minted crown, only to express some dissatisfaction with the seating, so he removed it, did a little remedial work, and finally the job was done. He handed me a mirror; I had to ask him, in all seriousness, which was the tooth he had treated. It was impossible to tell. This was serious, dedicated professional work. ‘Cherished’ is not a word I often use in connection with medical procedures, but here I felt cherished throughout. It’s common to hear people say ‘worth a detour’. Ocean Dental Centre is worth a very long detour indeed. Five stars, that being all the app will allow.

I visited this clinic while in severe pain. The dentist explained that they could not use an anesthetic because of my high blood pressure. I later learned that anesthetics without epinephrine are available, so I felt disappointed that option was not discussed.
I was prescribed Biocoxib and penicillin, although I had no clear signs of infection or inflammation. I was concerned about taking unnecessary antibiotics and other medication with increased cardiovascular risk.
Based on my experience, I did not feel my concerns were handled with enough care, and I personally would not return to this clinic.

I had several fillings, some complex and deep. I wasn't sure how it is going to go. However my experience with Dr. Namo and their nursing staff has been at the best I could imagine. It took 8 appointments, spread over 3 weeks and the final result has been exceptionally good. I am glad that I chose Ocean Dental. Dr. Namo is a brilliant young dentist knowledgeable, cautious and skillful. He explained his treatment strategies clearly. I recommend him to any expat or like myself coming for dental tourism.
The prices for treatment are very reasonable.

My experience was TOP NOTCH ! ! ! Read on if you'd like to know why.....
On an extended holiday I cracked an upper molar. Dr. Toto took x-rays and gave me a diagnosis and prognosis on the day I called. I was able to conveniently schedule all the needed dates for a root canal with a permanent crown. He and his staff were perfectly polite and professional. Every reasonable effort was implemented to reduce transmission of Covid-19.
I've never had a numbing agent injection before that was administered with so little discomfort. I didn't feel it. The absence of pain is pleasure. As long as Dr. Toto is actively treating patients and I am in Thailand, I will never use another dentist. I am 100% sure, I could not find a better dentist.
Price? I never checked around to compare. I can only say..... It seemed like a low price to me.
Thank you again Dr. Toto and to all your wonderful staff.
